access-assignment.title: Two paths to a seat
access-assignment.description: Check prerequisites, choose a plan-supported direct or organization assignment path, and review repository access independently.

policy-scope.title: Find the policy source
policy-scope.description: Trace the seat source, check delegated defaults or feature-specific organization conflicts, then confirm the setting on the actual surface.

consumption-controls.title: Find the actual limit
consumption-controls.description: Resolve the first applicable user-level budget by specificity; its hard stop precedes independent included-usage and metered controls.

budget-scenario.title: Two independent budget stops
budget-scenario.description: The worked example stops at the exhausted individual $15 ULB; the variant has ULB headroom but stops at an enforced metered limit.

agent-operating-scope.title: Bound an agent rollout
agent-operating-scope.description: Cloud policy and repository exclusion bound the pilot; repository write access then separates read-only sessions from proposed changes subject to checks and human review.

agent-tools-network.title: Evaluate an MCP server entry
agent-tools-network.description: Check managed-allowlist scope, built-in defaults, deny precedence and every deployed allowlist, while reviewing out-of-scope profiles and credentials separately.

instructions-context.title: Improve guidance through review
instructions-context.description: Choose a supported instruction scope, write task-relevant guidance and rerun a fresh-session task, refining it when the response lacks matching execution evidence.

model-feature-baseline.title: Review availability before rollout
model-feature-baseline.description: Record separate unconfigured GA defaults for models and features, check model release status and restrictions, then make an explicit decision and verify the eligible user's experience.

agent-activity.title: Choose evidence with care
agent-activity.description: Use sufficient existing session or audit evidence first; otherwise assess optional collection and preview eligibility, minimize capture and propose privacy controls before any change.

billing-ownership.title: Route a budget alert
billing-ownership.description: In the hypothetical pilot, the platform team owns seats, finance retains metered-spending approval authority and names an alert responder to investigate alerts.

sensitive-content.title: Use complementary protections
sensitive-content.description: Supported content exclusions leave access gaps, so independently restrict repository and filesystem access and review external tools, while retaining explicit residual risk.

adoption-measurement.title: Count distinct users, not summed totals
adoption-measurement.description: In the fictional completed period, organizations with 8 and 7 active users overlap by 3, yielding 12 distinct active users out of 20 assigned licenses, or 60%.

access-lifecycle.title: Maintain the seat lifecycle
access-lifecycle.description: A seat moves from assignment through onboarding and scoped review to an owner decision, with support and assignment-path waits before any authorized, timing-dependent removal.
